svg.title: Controlled-mindset citation network
svg.desc: Arrows point from citing to cited opinions. Circle area grows with incoming plus outgoing citations. Colors identify doctrinal connections. Concentric bands have equal visible areas. Selecting a node only highlights citation connections.

svg.text: 50 connections: solid = controlled mindset; dashed = other citations, including appellate review and history.
Each color marks affirmative judicial recognition that controlled mindset is relevant to a legal inquiry, even if insufficient on its own or unsupported on the facts. Mere
distinctions are not colored. Gray marks no affirmative doctrinal use. Multiple colors occupy equal visible areas within each circle. Click a case to highlight its citation
connections and matching legend colors; click it again or the background to clear. Click a color label to highlight all cases with that doctrinal use, without highlighting
